test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct sequence for central dogma.

options.text: Protein translation, DNA Replication, m-RNA transcription
DNA Replication, m-RNA transcription, Protein translation
m-RNA transcription, Protein translation, DNA Replication
m-RNA transcription, DNA Replication, Protein translation

solution:
The correct answer is __**DNA Replication, mRNA transcription, Protein translation .**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **process by which DNA is copied to RNA** is called **transcription**, and that by which **RNA is used to produce proteins** is called **translation**.
 
• The major steps of transcription are **initiation, promoter clearance, elongation, and termination**.
 
• Essentially, what happens during transcription is that **an mRNA “copies down” the instructions for making a protein** from DNA.
 
• DNA replication is the **process by which the genome's DNA is copied** in cells.
 
• The process of translation can be seen as the **decoding of instructions for making proteins**, involving mRNA in transcription as well as tRNA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d885884d008aeffbc804c583f27ef2d3ddc6211d497e2cec58bbdc89d987e9ed.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Deoxyribonucleic acid (abbreviated DNA) is the **molecule that carries genetic information** for the development and functioning of an organism.
 
• Ribonucleic acid (abbreviated RNA) is a **nucleic acid present in all living cells** that has structural similarities to DNA.
 
• **Proteins** are made up of hundreds or thousands of **smaller units called amino acids**, which are **attached to one another in long chains**.
 
• Proteins are **20 different types of amino acids** that can be combined to make a protein.
